recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7346 unless a future work group decision changes the current address search-parameter naming or scope.
issue_request: FHIR-7346 is a Published, Persuasive with Modification PA issue from the 2015 May/DSTU1 ballot asking that additional address subdivision search parameters be included, in addition to the existing address parameter, for Patient, Person, Practitioner, Location, Organization, and RelatedPerson.
initial_application: The issue references GForge/FHIR-3918, whose comments cite svn revision 5580. Git-svn commit 6ac5038c1361065b5474a33dfba0557da1ada2ed imported that revision with the message '#3918 - add additional search parameters to Address' and added address-city, address-state, address-postalcode, address-country, and address-use rows to the relevant resource spreadsheets. Later source refactors preserved those parameters in current search-parameter bundles.
additional_context: FHIR-3918 is the earlier same-change-family Published issue with the fuller rationale, and FHIR-7939 is a Duplicate of the same request. Current FHIR search codes use hyphenated names such as address-city and address-postalcode rather than the Jira resolution's older camelCase wording, and Organization now points to Organization.contact.address.* in the current model. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Active resource entries in source/fhir.ini cover Location, Organization, Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and Person, and each current bundle-*-search-params.xml file contains the broad address parameter plus address-city, address-country, address-postalcode, address-state, and address-use definitions, with address-use typed as token and the other subdivision parameters typed as string.
